# DOC interoperability fixture

`Bug49820.doc` is the Apache POI test document at `test-data/document/Bug49820.doc`.
It is included under the Apache License 2.0; see `LICENSE.Apache-2.0` in this
directory. The fixture exercises a real Word 97–2003 compound file with legacy
property-set offsets and an opaque code-page-dependent property.

Source: https://github.com/apache/poi/tree/trunk/test-data/document
